name: Connected agent (A2A)
summary: Caller agent that delegates to a remote agent via RemoteA2A connection.
description: Creates a caller Prompt Agent with an A2APreviewTool pointing at a callee Foundry Prompt Agent's auto-materialised `/endpoint/protocols/a2a` URL. The callee is self-provisioned (BYOM-routed model) and an AgentCard is attached via PATCH `/agents/{name}` to flip on the A2A endpoint. Validates BYOM prefix survives A2A wiring on both sides.
notes: Foundry agents CAN be A2A servers now — attaching an AgentCard via `PATCH /agents/{name}` (SDK doesn't surface this; use raw REST) materialises `/agents/{name}/endpoint/protocols/a2a`. BYOM routing survives that PATCH cleanly. Full caller→callee roundtrip currently fails with `Failed to fetch agent card: 401 Unauthorized` unless the caller uses a registered A2A connection (`A2A_PROJECT_CONNECTION_ID`) with matching credentials — that's a cross-agent auth issue, not a BYOM regression.
